snippet.title: Air Cavalry - SNES (1995)
snippet.description:
1995? Really? They couldn't do better than this?

As far as I can tell, there is no map. There is no strafing either, not that it matters because I don't think you're going to avoid enemy fire even if you had the ability to maneuver. 

Here's something that I've wondered. This game clearly borrows some elements from the Strike series. I know that for a military helicopter game, certain things are going to be similar, but there were something things I just had to laugh at. What I wonder about is why game devs didn't just embrace it. If you're going to borrow bits of Desert Strike, why not have fun with it? Make it a cartoony, over-the-top shooter. Throw in jokes. Name the characters badly. Lampoon the formula and make it an enjoyable B-game. EDF knew this and it worked. This is just boring.
